audit_hooks.connection_audit: verify every `connection_model` edge against source code, workflow configuration and live runtime receipt before marking connected/current
audit_hooks.credential_audit: key identity by surface+repo_or_worker+environment+purpose; same name != same secret
audit_hooks.language_audit: scan each language as an independent semantic/paradigm lens against canonical contracts
audit_hooks.call_graph_audit: forward and reverse traversal; detect service-binding cycles at request-path level, not merely graph topology
audit_hooks.token_efficiency: retrieve map first; then only the feature, functions, policy and evidence needed to answer the current uncertainty
audit_hooks.stale_data: runtime snapshots are dated evidence; refresh before mutation or production claims
audit_hooks.ai_provider_sync: compare public provider fleet JSON, Operations task fabric/catalog/runtime/probe and task-family set; flag count/list/authority drift
audit_hooks.ai_extractor_sync: ensure extraction_assist remains candidate-only and Operations extractor mapper never becomes a provider-selection authority
audit_hooks.extractor_type_contract: Foundation workflow consumes the Operations M11 source/inventory parity artifact; no public implementation authority is created.

credential_observations.finding: Identical variable names such as AUTH_TOKEN may exist in different secret stores.
credential_observations.action: Never deduplicate credentials by name. Scope identity by surface + repository/Worker + environment + purpose.

ai_scan_contract.privacy_rule: values are never stored in the AI map; only names/classes/purpose/scopes may be recorded when safe
ai_scan_contract.freshness_rule: runtime rows are snapshots and must be refreshed before mutation or production claims

inspired_patterns.name: AI Work Director
inspired_patterns.guard: do not override canonical ownership or acceptance dependencies

inspired_patterns.name: Cross-Fire Mesh
inspired_patterns.use: independent validation lanes with different boundaries
inspired_patterns.guard: shared writes serialized; duplicate searches do not count as independent evidence

inspired_patterns.name: Sparse Context Access
inspired_patterns.use: map-first retrieval of only required context
inspired_patterns.guard: current map is index; canonical files remain authority

inspired_patterns.name: Capability Negotiation
inspired_patterns.use: provider/tool/language adapter selection by capability instead of vendor
inspired_patterns.guard: policy decides eligibility before capability ranking

inspired_patterns.name: Latency Guard
inspired_patterns.guard: optimize tail phases, not only total duration

inspired_patterns.name: Shared Evidence Fabric
inspired_patterns.use: explicit artifact/receipt references across repos without sharing implementation authority
inspired_patterns.guard: shared evidence is not shared policy authority

inspired_patterns.name: Blind Differential
inspired_patterns.use: compare normalized outputs/resource/latency while hiding implementation identity where practical
inspired_patterns.guard: reveal identity only after primary comparison

inspired_patterns.name: Shim / Sidecar
inspired_patterns.use: thin non-authoritative edge around canonical authority
inspired_patterns.guard: bounded, observable, no second control plane

ai_brain_scheduling.lane_selection: owner + mutation_surface + dependency readiness + evidence tier + expected cost + deadline
ai_brain_scheduling.rebalancing: blocked lanes work-steal; finished lanes pull next independent task
ai_brain_scheduling.measurement: latency and retrieval-cost telemetry become scheduler feedback
ai_brain_scheduling.fairness: no starvation of older acceptance-critical work; deadlines and evidence gates outrank raw throughput
